hub.title: Bookings with an island breeze.
hub.subtitle: Barbershops, salons and spas in Turks and Caicos. Explore the three parts of Breeze with fake data.

client.title: Client app
client.desc: Search salons, pick services and a professional, see real availability and book in seconds.

panel.title: Salon panel
panel.desc: Color-coded agenda per professional, phone bookings and team setup with unique colors.

live.title: Breeze Live
live.desc: Kiosk screen for the salon TV: today's agenda by column and live booking alerts.

hub.tip1: Open Breeze Live in one tab (Coral Salon & Nails).
hub.tip2: In another tab, book at Coral Salon from the client app or create a phone booking in the panel.
hub.tip3: Watch the alert appear on Live instantly with the professional's color. Turn on the sound with the speaker button.
